debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)

whiteList.title: Whitelist (individual devices)
whiteList.description: By default NO devices are created at all. Check individual states/devices here via checkbox to enable them specifically.

idPrefixes.title: Prefix filter (whole adapter instances)
idPrefixes.description: An alternative to the whitelist for enabling many devices at once: e.g. "shelly.0." enables ALL discovered Shelly devices of that instance, without checking each one individually. Can be combined with the whitelist.

blackList.title: Blacklist
blackList.description: These states are NEVER created - takes precedence over both the whitelist AND the prefix filter.

customDevices.title: Device builder
customDevices.description: Choose a device type, then enter the state IDs it needs and save. Always created, independent of the whitelist/prefix filter. Useful for devices that are not (correctly) found by automatic discovery.

type.title: Device type
enumNames: Blind with current and target position

invert.title: Invert value (e.g. if true=open instead of true=closed)

rolePrefixes.title: ioBroker roles to search
rolePrefixes.description: Only states with one of these roles (or starting with one of these prefixes, e.g. "switch.") are considered as possible devices at all. The default covers switches and blinds.

requireDeviceName.title: Only consider states with a real device name
requireDeviceName.description: Off by default, since many real devices (e.g. Shelly before being renamed manually) have no channel/device name set and would otherwise be incorrectly excluded. Only enable this for a consistently, cleanly named installation, to hide leftover entries (loose script variables).

excludeIdSubstrings.title: Exclusion substrings
excludeIdSubstrings.description: States whose ID contains one of these substrings are completely excluded from automatic discovery (e.g. script/data-storage namespaces that are never real devices).

iobrokerDataDir.title: ioBroker data directory
iobrokerDataDir.description: Path to iobroker-data, used to automatically detect the host/port of the states database (works for both file mode and Redis mode).

invertBlindPosition.title: Invert blind position
invertBlindPosition.description: Enable this if blinds move in the wrong direction (0/100 swapped between ioBroker and Matter).
